title: Your whole game at a glance
description: Minimap, clock and current quest on one screen, so you can stop opening menus and keep playing.

title: A living world
description: Flocks and murmurations of starlings, butterflies, auroras, shooting stars, morning mist, leaping fish, the sound of waves, crickets, owls and frogs: Minecraft's world is beautiful but strangely empty, and this makes it feel inhabited.

title: World map and markers
description: Every chunk you explore, on one map with your own markers, so you can find your way back without writing coordinates down.

title: Backpack
description: 54 more slots in their own equipment slot, crafted from vanilla items, for the trips where your inventory fills up too soon.

title: Compass minimap
description: Equip a compass to see the land around you, your biome and your coordinates, so you stop getting lost or pressing F3.

title: The Milky Way at night
description: A faint Milky Way, with shooting stars crossing it, so that clear nights are worth looking up at.

title: Auroras over the snow
description: Every other clear night over snowy land, green and violet curtains of light hang to the north, under the Milky Way.

title: Colored lights
description: Each light tints what it lights with its own color: a lantern warm, redstone red, soul fire blue, amethyst purple. No shader pack needed.

title: Caves in their own light
description: Glow lichen lights a great cave in its own pale green, rather than one flat white light.

title: A sea with a horizon
description: The sea ends on a clean curve and the sun sets behind it, instead of showing through the water. No shader pack needed.

title: Under the sea
description: Under water, the sky only shows overhead, the sun glowing through the waves, and the depths are dim and cloudy, as in a real sea.

title: Quest journal
description: Twelve optional chapters that follow Minecraft's own advancements, so you always know what to do next without opening a wiki.

title: Clock and weather forecast
description: Equip a clock to read the time and the day at a glance, and a barometer for the weather ahead, so night and storms stop catching you out.

title: An inventory that keeps up
description: Sorting, stashing, search, locked slots, Shulker box previews, hand refill, bulk and chain crafting, hotbar rows: managing items is what survival asks of you most, so it should take a click, not a minute.

title: Combat awareness
description: With a sculk compass, mobs show their health and warn you when they start chasing you, so you are never surprised from behind.

title: Naturalist's spyglass
description: A naturalist's spyglass reads a horse's speed, jump and health from afar, so you can pick a good one without taming them all.

title: Waystone
description: Fast travel between the waystones you know, crafted only after reaching the End, so that it spares late-game walking without shortening the adventure.

title: Stables
description: Register your horses at a hitching post, name them for free and tie them to its rail, so you never lose one again.

title: Elytra slot
description: Elytra get their own slot, so you can fly with your chestplate on instead of choosing between the two.

title: Right-click harvest
description: Right-click a ripe crop: it is harvested and replanted, so farming stops being a chore of breaking and replacing.

title: Filtered hopper
description: Every hopper gets a filter slot, so you can sort items without building a giant redstone machine.

title: A pirate's booty
description: Very rarely, a pile of barrels hidden in a lush cave, full of gold, emeralds, diamonds and enchanted books.

title: The sea
description: Murky depths where drowned come out of the gloom barely 16 blocks away, so that diving is an expedition rather than a swim.

title: Diving mask
description: Five leather around a glass pane: the view under water stays sharp and twice as long, and its snorkel lets you breathe just under the surface.

title: Towns
description: Now and then, a town stands where a village would: three times the houses, packed close together along its streets.

title: Lighthouses
description: Rarely, on the coasts, a white tower and its keeper's cottage, a chest of supplies inside and often a spyglass up by the lamp.

title: A lighthouse at dusk
description: At night, far out at sea, you see its light flash as the beam turns toward you: a landmark to sail home by.

title: A shepherd's hut
description: Now and then, out in the wild, a lone home and the villager living there: here a shepherd, with sheep in the pen.

title: A fisherman's shack
description: On a river's bank, its deck on stilts over the water, with a ladder down to your boat.

title: Glowing plankton
description: On some nights, banks of plankton drift in warm seas and light up an electric blue wherever the water is stirred: waves on the shore, a boat's wake, a swimmer.

title: Sandstorms
description: When it rains, a sandstorm sweeps the deserts and badlands: the view closes in, the wind howls, and sand piles up on the dunes.

title: Blizzards
description: Where it snows, the rain brings a blizzard: snow blowing past on a wind you can hear, the hills fading into white.

title: Morning mist
description: About one morning in eight starts in a thick mist that lifts as the sun climbs, so that mornings don't all look the same.

title: Butterflies and pollen
description: Butterflies around flowers and pollen in the air, small signs of life that make a meadow feel like one.

title: Robins in the trees
description: Now and then a robin perches on a tree top near you, hops about and sings, and flies off as you come near. Sneak up on it to get closer.

title: Squirrels on the trunks
description: Now and then a red squirrel comes down a tree trunk, stops on the bark or nibbles something at its foot, and runs back up into the leaves as you come near. Sneak up on it to get closer.

title: Leafy creepers
description: A small bush on four legs, its leaves and twigs a bit different on each one, and a ribcage that glows when it's about to blow, so creepers fit in next to the game's newer mobs.

title: Biomes on the world map
description: Hold Shift over the map to read a place's biome and, once you have been to the Nether, where a portal there would lead, so you can find that swamp again and link portals without doing the math.

title: A refined interface
description: A recipe book drawn like a real one, because every screen should share one style rather than look bolted on.

title: Sculk torch
description: A sculk torch shows where monsters can spawn, so you can light up your base properly without a debug overlay.

title: Woodcutter
description: A stonecutter for wood: every piece one plank can make, in one click, so you stop filling crafting grids and wasting planks.

title: Advancements
description: A clearer advancements screen that shows what is left in each tab, because vanilla hides most of it until you get there.

title: Travel between waystones
description: Each waystone lists the others you know, by name and dimension, so that traveling is a choice in a list and not a guess.

title: Your horses at a glance
description: Every horse you registered, where it is, and its speed, jump and health. Board one, take it out at any post, or call it back from far away.

title: Food preview
description: With food in hand, the drumsticks it would restore blink in your hunger bar, so you don't waste a good meal on a nearly full stomach.

title: Beehives through the spyglass
description: Look at a beehive through the spyglass to read its honey and its bees, so you know when to harvest without breaking anything.

title: World loading screen
description: While a world loads, your explored map fills in with color around you, so the wait shows where you are about to land.

title: World selection
description: Game mode, last session and time played beside each world, so you can tell your saves apart at a glance.

title: Info panels
description: A small "!" on the furnace tells you the cooking time and what the fuel has left, so you don't have to guess or count.

title: Boss bars
description: Framed in dark iron between two skulls, the bar leaves the health just lost as a pale trail and adds up your damage by the boss's name, so you see every blow land.

title: Small tweaks
description: With redstone dust in hand, look at a wire to read its power, so you can debug a circuit without counting blocks.

title: Copper tweaks
description: With a honeycomb or an axe in hand, look at copper to see whether it is waxed, since vanilla makes both look exactly the same.

title: Bookshelf tweaks
description: Look at a chiseled bookshelf's slot to read that book's title and enchantments, so you don't have to take each one out.

title: Chest tweaks
description: Look at a chest, barrel or Shulker box renamed at the anvil to read its name, so you know what is inside without opening it. Note blocks, jukeboxes and shelved books tell you what they hold the same way.

title: Armor stand tweaks
description: Arms and 13 poses, to match Bedrock Edition and let you pose your stands: Java Edition only offers this through commands.
